title: Beyond tables: images in the engine, their near copies and their scenes caught
request: Phase 4: extend DCLab beyond tables to image classification and other uses.
spec: The embedded machine reads images from pixel columns (pixel_prefix), encodes them with a centred local baseline, finds near copies on the pixels, holds out whole scenes; the shapes replica as an image table; the image acceptance; the code export.
plan: Keep images inside the embedded kind, as image tables come (pixels as columns).
Find copies on the pictures, classify on features.
Check the trap is caught on several seeds, not only that the split is by scene.

decisions.decision: Images stay in the embedded kind, not a new kind.
decisions.why: The kind already owns the words for images; a second kind would split the Home's detection.

decisions.decision: Near copies are found on pixels averaged to a grid, not on the classifier's features.
decisions.why: Features built to classify pull every image of a class together: a copy and another image of its class looked alike.

change: embeddings (Pixels, Centred, pixel_columns, images_of, calibrate sources), shapes_table, EmbeddedMachine image path, image_case and accept_image_engine, code export of images.

findings.defect: An existing acceptance test counted the new image checks as text checks.
findings.scenario: The test filtered checks by their prefix and found 7, not 5.
findings.cause: The image checks shared the text checks' wording.
findings.fix: The image checks are named images: and asserted beside the texts.

findings.defect: The near-copy trap was not caught: the check passed by 0.0002 at one seed and failed at another.
findings.scenario: Every pair of images had a cosine near 0.998; two shots of a scene counted as different pairs in calibration.
findings.cause: Rectified pooled features are all alike, and calibration ignored the sources.
findings.fix: Copies are found on pixels; calibration leaves same-source pairs out; the check requires most shot pairs flagged and almost no other pair, on seeds 0 to 3.

findings.defect: Pixel columns were ordered as text.
findings.scenario: pixel10 came before pixel2: an MNIST-style table's images were scrambled.
findings.fix: Ordered by the number after the prefix; a name without one is refused.

findings.defect: An image project's code export would not run.
findings.scenario: It read a text column that images do not have.
findings.fix: The export writes the image path and reproduces the holdout.

findings.defect: A forbidden pixel was still read while the evidence said kept out.
findings.scenario: The person forbids px_0042 as a watermark.
findings.cause: The image branch skipped the text branch's checks.
findings.fix: A forbidden pixel and a source equal to the target are refused when the solution is saved.

findings.defect: The check demanded no near copy across the holdout line.
findings.scenario: At seed 3 two scenes that look alike sit on both sides: 16 pairs.
findings.cause: A scene's shots never straddle the line; two alike scenes may.
findings.fix: The engine reports and warns about them; the check asks that they are reported, not absent.

outcome: Images run in the engine to their holdout, their near copies and scenes caught on four seeds, and their code reproduces the number.
lessons: Find copies on the data itself; a classifier's features are built to make different items alike.
risks: The encoder is a baseline, not pretrained; decision sets for image points are not built.
